summary: Harmony Gold Mining Co Ltd filed a Form 6-K announcing an upgrade of its MSCI ESG rating from BB to A as assessed in March 2026. The filing is a routine press release disclosing improved ESG scores in water management, emissions, waste reduction, and governance. No transaction, stakeholder change, board shakeup, or strategic action is involved. As a foreign private issuer report under Rule 13a-16, this is informational only and does not constitute a special situation. The upgrade is an operational milestone, not an event-triggering corporate action.
